caption:
🔥 बॉलीवुड के हैंडसम हंक ऋतिक रोशन ने मचा दिया है ग्लोबल लेवल पर गदर!

लॉस एंजिल्स में हुए 15वें LACMA Art Film Gala में ऋतिक बने पहले भारतीय अभिनेता। 🌟
प्रैस रिलीज़ के मुताबिक, ये इवेंट 7 नवंबर की शाम को हुआ था जिसे Gucci ने बैक किया था।
इवेंट में ऋतिक Brunello Cucinelli के कस्टम टक्सीडो में बेहद शानदार लग रहे थे। 👔
इस चैरिटी इवेंट में फिल्ममेकर Denis Villeneuve और आर्टिस्ट Vija Celmins को सम्मानित किया गया।
गाला को Leonardo DiCaprio और Eva Chow ने को-चेयर किया था और ऋतिक को Kavita Gupta ने होस्ट किया। ✨
वहाँ Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Timothee Chalamet और Nicole Kidman जैसे हॉलीवुड स्टार्स भी मौजूद थे।
क्या आपने ऋतिक का ये इंटरनेशनल लुक देखा? 🎬

ctx.title: Hrithik Roshan becomes first Indian actor to attend LACMA Art Film Gala, rubs shoulders with Leonardo DiCaprio, Timothee Chalamet, Nicole Kidman
ctx.summary: Hrithik Roshan made a stylish appearance at the LACMA Art Film Gala in Los Angeles, joining an illustrious gathering of Hollywood stars.
ctx.text:
Bollywood superstar Hrithik Roshan made a stylish appearance at the LACMA (Los Angeles County Museum of Art) Art Film Gala in Los Angeles, joining an illustrious gathering of Hollywood actors, filmmakers, artists and global cultural icons at the 15th edition of the event.
Hrithik looked stunning in a custom tuxedo from Italian luxury fashion brand Brunello Cucinelli, known for its philosophy of quiet luxury and humanistic capitalism, according to a press release.
The annual invite-only charity event honoured filmmaker Denis Villeneuve , best known for directing Dune, and artist Vija Celmins for their contributions to filmmaking and the arts.
The gala brings together prominent personalities from the worlds of cinema, art, fashion, business and philanthropy, with its guest list featuring Hollywood stars, international artists and influential entrepreneurs.
Hrithik's presence marked a notable moment for Indian representation at the prestigious cultural gathering, as he became the first mainstream Indian actor to attend.
Held on the evening of November 7, the annual gala, backed by luxury fashion house Gucci, celebrates the intersection of art, film and culture. The event was co-chaired by Hollywood actor Leonardo DiCaprio and entrepreneur and cultural tastemaker Eva Chow, as per the press release.
Hrithik was hosted at the gala by Kavita Gupta, an Indian-origin producer, venture capitalist and member of the International Emmy Board, who has been championing Indian talent on the international stage.
The star-studded evening also featured several prominent Hollywood personalities, including Leonardo DiCaprio , Tom Hanks, Timothée Chalamet, Nicole Kidman, Andrew Garfield, Anya Taylor-Joy, Rufus Sewell, Ashley Park, Jessica Williams and Monica Barbaro.
Entrepreneurs and global fashion personalities, including Kylie Jenner and Kim Kardashian, were also among those in attendance.
The LACMA Art Film Gala is an annual celebration that brings together influential voices from the worlds of art and cinema, recognising individuals whose work has made a significant contribution to the creative landscape.
